stories.title: Fiji declara emergência nacional após aumento de casos de HIV

en.title: Fiji declares national emergency following increase in HIV cases
en.summary: Fiji has declared a national emergency in response to a rise in HIV cases in the country.

stories.title: Reajuste do Bolsa Família: governo diz que reposição da inflação não viola lei eleitoral

en.title: Bolsa Família adjustment: government says inflation replacement does not violate electoral law
en.summary: Brazil's Finance Ministry stated that a 15.04% adjustment to the Bolsa Família program, raising the minimum benefit from 600 to 691 reais starting in October, constitutes inflation compensation rather than a new benefit increase and therefore does not breach electoral legislation.

stories.title: Diante da crise no STF, Fachin toma duas decisões no mesmo dia: cancela sessão e adia julgamento de Mendonça

en.title: Amid STF crisis, Fachin makes two decisions on same day: cancels session and delays Mendonça ruling
en.summary: STF President Edson Fachin canceled an extraordinary plenary session and postponed a judgment regarding Minister André Mendonça's conduct in investigations related to Banco Master, following escalating internal tensions and public disputes among justices.

stories.title: Fachin suspende sessão do STF que analisaria relatório sobre Mendonça

en.title: Fachin suspends STF session that would analyze report on Mendonça
en.summary: STF President Edson Fachin announced the suspension of proceedings examining allegations of abuse of authority against Minister André Mendonça.

stories.title: Fachin adia julgamento sobre atos de Mendonça no caso das mensagens entre Moraes e Vorcaro

en.title: Fachin postpones judgment on Mendonça's actions in case of messages between Moraes and Vorcaro
en.summary: A Brazilian Supreme Court justice has delayed a ruling concerning actions taken by Mendonça related to messages exchanged between two officials.

stories.title: Primeiro-ministro da Suécia anuncia renúncia após derrota em eleições parlamentares

en.title: Prime Minister of Sweden announces resignation after defeat in parliamentary elections
en.summary: Sweden's prime minister has announced his resignation following the country's parliamentary election results.

stories.title: PF prende sócio da Pixbet em investigação sobre suspeita de lavagem de dinheiro e evasão de divisas

en.title: Federal Police arrest Pixbet partner in investigation into suspected money laundering and currency evasion
en.summary: Brazilian federal police have arrested a partner of betting company Pixbet as part of an investigation into alleged money laundering and illegal currency movements.

stories.title: Fiji declara emergência nacional por HIV com 1 caso a cada 60 pessoas

en.title: Fiji declares national emergency for HIV with 1 case per 60 people
en.summary: Fiji's health ministry has declared a national HIV emergency, with infection rates rising dramatically to affect one person in every 60 residents, compared to one in 167 five years ago.

stories.title: PF prende Diomar Dantas, empresário e sócio minoritário da Pixbet, na Paraíba

en.title: Federal Police arrest Diomar Dantas, businessman and minority partner of Pixbet, in Paraíba
en.summary: Federal Police arrested Diomar Tadeu Dantas de Farias, a minority partner at Pixbet, in Paraíba as part of the second phase of Operation Arena.

stories.title: Governo Lula reajusta Bolsa Família em 15% a menos de três semanas das eleições

en.title: Lula government increases Bolsa Família by 15% less than three weeks before elections
en.summary: The Lula administration announced a 15 percent increase to Bolsa Família benefits less than three weeks ahead of presidential elections.

stories.title: Primeiro-ministro da Suécia anuncia renúncia após vitória da centro-esquerda em eleições

en.title: Prime Minister of Sweden announces resignation after center-left victory in elections
en.summary: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson announced his resignation following his coalition's loss in parliamentary elections.

stories.title: Lula anuncia reajuste de 15% no Bolsa Família a 17 dias do primeiro turno

en.title: Lula announces 15% increase in Bolsa Família 17 days before first round
en.summary: President Lula announced a 15.04 percent increase to Bolsa Família, raising the minimum payment from R$ 600 to R$ 691, just before the presidential election.

stories.title: Ex-vereador Milton Leite presidiu a Câmara 6 vezes e ficou 27 anos como parlamentar

en.title: Former councilman Milton Leite chaired the Chamber 6 times and served 27 years as parliamentarian
en.summary: Milton Leite, a former São Paulo city councilman, served as a city legislator for 27 years and presided over the municipal chamber on six occasions. He accumulated significant influence in local politics and currently holds leadership positions in his political party and federation.

stories.title: EcoRodovias intensifica inovação para trânsito mais seguro

en.title: EcoRodovias intensifies innovation for safer traffic
en.summary: EcoRodovias is expanding its use of artificial intelligence and high-definition equipment to identify risky driving behaviors and support preventive measures on highways. The company aims to enhance traffic safety through technology and data analysis during Brazil's National Traffic Week.

stories.title: Premiê da Suécia renuncia após derrota do bloco governista nas eleições legislativas

en.title: Sweden's Prime Minister resigns after governing bloc's defeat in legislative elections
en.summary: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson submitted his resignation following the final vote count from legislative elections. The center-left opposition coalition led by the Social Democrats won 176 parliamentary seats while Kristersson's right-wing bloc secured 173 seats.

stories.title: Ibovespa volta a subir após 'susto' com reajuste do Bolsa Família, enquanto dólar e juros têm leve alta

en.title: Ibovespa rises again after 'scare' with Bolsa Família adjustment, while dollar and interest rates edge up
en.summary: Brazil's stock market recovered after concerns over a Bolsa Família increase triggered market volatility. Future interest rates declined following the central bank meeting while the dollar fell and stock indices showed mixed performance driven by sector-specific movements.

stories.title: STF cancela sessão plenária desta quinta-feira

en.title: Supreme Court cancels plenary session scheduled for Thursday
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court canceled an extraordinary plenary session scheduled for Thursday. The court president cited the need for private meetings with justices ahead of a ruling on a Federal Police report involving messages related to Justice Alexandre de Moraes.
